note: 2026 store signs from Steven's Oct 23 2026 footage; built by tools/stores/signs/sign_2026.gd. Edit y26/parts/<id>.json and run make_signs_2026.py.

signs.ref: IMG_4482 photo (full res, oblique ~35 deg; squared up on the letters' top and base lines); IMG_4483, IMG_4481 (whole word, smaller), IMG_4492 f009 (close oblique, returns)
signs.notes: Red-pink lit channel letters 'AÉROPOSTALE' (bold condensed caps, acute on the E), dark maroon returns. In the footage the letters hang just INSIDE the glass, in the top of the centre opening of a matte-black riveted steel portal (the black header behind them); here they are put on the black fascia, which reads the same from the hall. Font Oswald Bold (OFL) tracked open, matches widths within ~3%. The squaring aspect is inferred from the font fit (only oblique views exist), so letter width +-8%. Size from a person in IMG_4481: caps ~0.42 m, word ~3.2 m. The palm in front hides the bottom of STALE in every view.

signs.ref: IMG_4442 contact-sheet f007 (globe + 'AT&', oblique; squared up), f008 (square-on 'AT&T', globe cut off: letter widths)
signs.notes: The current AT&T mark: blue striped globe (the stripes read as dark gaps cut into its left side; traced, three visible) then 'AT&T' in white heavy geometric sans, both lit faces, on the black metal fascia band over a wide open storefront with grey slate-tile pilasters. Returns look black (they vanish into the band). Letters set in Inter Bold at 0.9 width to match the square-on f008 tile (AT&T is 3.3x its cap height there). The squared reference leans slightly (letters rise to the right); the 'T' is off its right edge. Cap height ~0.5 m from the ~1.2 m band; globe ~0.75 m.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 sheet tiles f025 ('Anne's' + right half of the pretzel, ~19 px caps) and f024 ('Au' at the wall's left edge); the full-res f025 frame shows Cell Xpert instead
signs.notes: Low-res reading (only seen at contact-sheet size, at the edge of two frames). Bright-blue lit channel letters (Auntie Anne's current lettering, set in Fredoka Bold as the closest rounded bold) with a yellow pretzel outline mark, straight on a big navy wall above the counter; order read as 'Auntie' [pretzel] 'Anne's' because f024 shows 'Au' right at the wall's left edge and f025 shows the pretzel right before 'Anne's'. The pretzel is drawn as a simple symmetric knot from its visible right half (left half mirrored). Sizes from the neighbouring Cell Xpert letters, +-25%. A better frame of this store would fix order, font and pretzel.

signs.ref: IMG_4442 f009 (oblique from the left, letters ~50 px; squared up on the panel); also clear in the IMG_4442 f008 full-res frame (signs/att_IMG_4442_f008.jpg), IMG_4440 f031 far
signs.notes: Black dry-brush script 'Avant-Garde' (with a few paint flecks, too small to build) on a brushed / diamond-plate aluminium panel hung in the storefront over the entry, below the plain cream mall bulkhead; the front itself is dark rusty steel framing with expanded-metal mesh panels. Unlit. Traced from a soft oblique view (letters ~50 px tall), so the stroke detail is approximate: 'vant' and 'arde' merge into blobs where the blur joins them. Letters read as thin flat-cut black (a slight shadow shows depth). Size from the ~2.2 m door below: panel about 2.7 x 0.9 m (guess).

signs.ref: IMG_4440 f009 (near square-on, letters ~125 px; squared up on the gingham surround, whose checks are square: aspect 5:1); f008-f010
signs.notes: Traced from the lit faces (they threshold cleanly). White internally lit channel letters, the brand's current sans wordmark 'Bath & Body Works', mounted straight on the store's blue/white gingham-check tile surround (navy, mid blue, pale grey-blue and white 6-7 in checks round the whole opening). The builder has no patterned fascia, so the fascia is the gingham's average blue; a gingham texture would be needed to match. Size from the checks (~2.6 mm/px): cap height ~0.32 m, 3.67 m long. A small duplicate 'Bath & Body Works' sign sits on the return wall (f012) and a blade sign down the hall; not modelled here.

signs.ref: IMG_4492 f020 (square-on, sharp; squared up on the sign panel's corners), IMG_4434 photo and IMG_4484 f015 (confirm)
signs.notes: Matte black rectangular sign box (~8 cm deep) on the glossy black fascia band of the ex-Woolworth unit, with thin flat-cut gold/brass lettering (unlit, a little metallic): small 'THE' between two tapered rules, big condensed flared-serif 'BILLIARD', and letter-spaced 'ROOM' between two tapered rules. All traced from 4492 f020 squared up on the panel corners (panel aspect ~2.45:1 from the IMG_4434 photo). Size: panel ~2.5 x 1.0 m (guess from the ~4 m open front below), BILLIARD caps ~0.42 m.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f029 (oblique from the right, squared up on the fascia panel, aspect 3.4:1); f028, f030

Boost's current logo as lit push-through faces on one black contour-cut backer (the 'contour' part, ~9 cm deep, standing off the panel): the orange bolt/arrow mark with its black slit, white lowercase 'boost', smaller white 'mobile' (the tiny TM is dropped). Letters lit (white faces read bluish, orange glows) with no light on the wall. Mounted on the light warm-grey fascia panel. Size from the opening and panel (~2.8 mm/px), +-15%.

signs.ref: IMG_4459 contact-sheet f005 (square-on, 'C' cut off at the left), f011 (whole word, oblique); IMG_4461 f007 (partial)
signs.notes: Bold retro brush script 'Cakelicious' with cream-yellow faces and red returns, plus a red offset 'shadow' layer behind (down and right), flat-cut and unlit, on a salmon-pink fascia band under a white crown cornice; white Tuscan columns frame the glass front, pink interior. Too soft to trace (letters ~30 px in the sheet tiles), so set in Pacifico at 1.12 width, which matches the looped k/l, the round o/u and the upswept final s; the 'C' is out of frame in the square-on view and is Pacifico's. x-height ~0.21 m from the ~1 m pink band.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f026 (oblique from below-right, squared up on the fascia panel, aspect 3.1:1); f025
signs.notes: Lit channel letters with black returns on the cream fascia panel: a red rounded-blob icon holding a white phone (the phone's thin dark outline is not modelled), red 'Cell' (traced), then white 'Xpert' with an oversized X that drops below the baseline. 'Xpert' is set in Poppins Bold (condensed and tightened to the frame) because a palm in front of the store hides the bottoms of 'ert'; X and 'pert' are separate parts so the big X keeps its size. Aspect of the squared-up panel and the 1.2 m panel height are estimates (+-12%).

signs.ref: IMG_4467 photo (full res, oblique; affine-rectified so the round plaque is a circle); IMG_4465/4468 (square-on, smaller), IMG_4464/4466
signs.notes: Dimensional logo plaque (two or three identical ones round the kiosk, on the gold/tan bulkhead above a burgundy-and-cream checker band): an arched burgundy banner box (~10 cm deep, black sides) with 'cinnamonster(R)' in cream serif lowercase, and a deep round black disc in front of its lower middle (~24 cm can, wall-mounted, deeper than the banner) with a tan field, a cream ring line, cream ring text 'MONSTER CINNAMON ROLLS' / 'GOURMET' and the cream cartoon monster holding a cinnamon roll (printed: vinyl layers). Not built: the Community Coffee wood panel inside, the hanging banner, and the second/third copies of the plaque (format has one sign per store).

Size estimated from the ~12 m entrance: word ~4.0 m, D ~0.78 m tall (+-15%). The exterior wall signs (dark charcoal flat letters on peach EIFS) are separate signs and not built here.

signs.ref: IMG_4438 sheet tile f014 (the clearest square-ish view; enlarged 4x and squared up on the gold band, aspect 5.3:1), tiles f012-f013 and signs/djs_IMG_4438_f014.jpg (palm in front) for layout
signs.notes: Gold/champagne (metallic-leaf look) band about 0.75 m tall running along the storefront between glossy black fascia above and below. Big interlocking 'DJS' monogram in polished silver/chrome flat-cut letters (thin serif strokes, the J's tail loops below the band onto the black), over small widely spaced black caps 'J E W E L E R S' (font, sourcesans) on the band. Unlit letters, lit by the soffit downlights. Monogram traced from a contact-sheet tile (the only clear view; the full-res frame has a palm in front), so its strokes are soft: thin hairlines may be over-thick (low-med confidence on the exact shape). Scouts said gold letters on black: the frames show silver letters on a gold band. Band length visible ~4.2 m (it continues left out of frame). Small white 'DJS' plaque on the H4 pier (IMG_4477) not built.

signs.ref: none readable. Possibly IMG_4442 sheet f001-f004 (the unit just before the skylight court and AT&T in the same clip)
signs.notes: No House of Fadez sign appears anywhere in the footage (the scouts found no sighting). The layout puts the barbershop next to AT&T; in clip IMG_4442 the unit filmed just before AT&T (sheet f001-f004) is a closed store with its security grille down, a pale aqua glass-tile front with glass-block pilasters, and a fascia of aqua tiles showing only two rows of empty letter-mounting holes: its sign has been taken down. If that is the Fadez unit, the 2026 truth is no sign, which is what this spec builds (aqua fascia, no letters). If a name sign is wanted anyway, the most likely look is white flat-cut sans caps 'HOUSE OF FADEZ' (with 'BARBERSHOP' smaller beneath), but nothing in the footage confirms the lettering, colours or that it is still open.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 contact-sheet f007 (only view: oblique from below, 'Foot Lock' in frame, the 'er' cut off), f006
signs.notes: Seen only in the contact-sheet tile IMG_4440 f007 (the signs/ full-res file named f007 shows the corridor, not the sign), oblique from below with 'Foot Lock' in frame. Red-face lit channel letters, light grey/silver returns about 12 cm deep, on a brushed stainless/grey metal fascia band over a full-glass front. Mixed case, very heavy, slightly italic, large x-height: set in Inter Black sheared 0.12. The view is foreshortened ~2x horizontally, so the letters' true width can't be read off the frame: the width is the font's natural width, and the check box is stretched to the partial view (letter shapes and weights compare, not the overall width). No stripe/referee logo seen (it may be off frame to the right). Cap height 0.55 m is a guess from the fascia band.

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f013 (contact-sheet tile only: blurred, oblique, top cut off; used enlarged as the reference), f012 tile (bottom of COOKIES over the red bulkhead), signs/gac_IMG_4439_f013.jpg (full res, only the bottoms of C-O-O-K: colours and white returns)
signs.notes: Counter-unit kiosk sign above the red bulkhead (dark-red band with downlights; a colour-changing LED box on the left corner). 'COOKIES' in fat rounded caps, one colour per letter: C blue, O yellow, O red, K green, I yellow, E blue, S red; lit faces with deep WHITE returns (the full-res frame shows the white sides clearly). 'GREAT AMERICAN' above in red lit caps with a heavy white outline/returns; its top is cut off in every frame, so its exact face, size and spacing are a guess (font Titan One like COOKIES; the real wordmark may be a different heavy face). COOKIES letters are fonted (Titan One, OFL) because no sharp square-on view exists; letter widths match the blurred tile within ~10%. The real letters bounce slightly (not level); built level. Size from the bulkhead downlights: COOKIES ~2.9 m, caps ~0.45 m. Low confidence on GREAT AMERICAN.

signs.ref: IMG_4443 f009 (square-on, letters ~150 px; right end cut at the period), sheet f009 (panel ends just after 'inc.')
signs.notes: Traced. Green-faced letters with navy returns and a navy trim line, unlit as far as the frame shows (no light on the panel), lowercase rounded 'games, inc.' plus the green alien mascot waving at left, overhanging the white panel at top and bottom. Mascot eyes/pupils are thin flat overlays on its face (dz). The real panel is a raised white panel inside a lighter grey recessed panel framed by mustard 12-in tiles (the fascia colour here is the grey panel; the ochre tile surround is not expressible). The period was cut by the frame edge and redrawn as a dot the size of the i's dot. Size from the 12-in fascia tiles (~1.95 mm/px).

signs.ref: IMG_4478 photo (full res, from below-left; squared up on the steel panel's four corners, aspect 1.75:1 from the perspective); IMG_4477 (oblique, far)

Red lit 'GNC' logo, a thin tapering white-blue rule, and 'Live Well.' in a white serif, all lit push-through faces (read pale ice-blue in the photo: white LEDs). All three traced from the full-res photo. Panel size from the 3.0 m opening: ~1.5 x 0.88 m (+-10%); aspect of the panel from perspective, +-5%.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 contact-sheet f030 ('-5' close, squared up on the 5), f021 and IMG_4442 f009 (whole word, very oblique / far)
signs.notes: Lowercase 'hi-5' in lime-green flat-cut acrylic (about 3 cm, glossy, unlit) on the light warm-grey fascia band of a candy/snack shop (black storefront, Red Bull and candy inside). Only the '-5' is seen close (sheet f030): a condensed squared 5 with a straight stem, square bowl and up-turned tail, matched by Saira Extra Condensed Bold; 'hi' is only seen edge-on (f021) and far (4442 f009) as two narrow uprights, so its letterforms are the font's. The check box is fitted on the 5 only (the 'hi' falls off the left of the reference). Cap height ~0.55 m guessed from the band; the word is small, about 1 m wide.

signs.ref: IMG_4484 f022 (mall side, oblique, squared up on the red band's edges; the final Y is off the frame edge), f019/f020 (whole word, far), f026 (HYPE close)
signs.notes: Mall-side sign: polished chrome/silver flat-cut letters (mirror faces: they show the ceiling lights' streaks; the small 'RACE TRACK' reads dark only because it mirrors the dark windows opposite) on the matte red painted band (~1.5 m tall) that runs the whole front, unlit. 'HYPERVELOCITY' traced from f022 squared up on the band's top and bottom edges (the horizontal scale of that squaring is judged from the letter shapes, +-10%); the last Y is off the frame edge in every close frame, so it is a copy of the Y in HYPER placed at the same letter spacing (f019/f020 confirm the word ends in Y). 'RACE TRACK' set in Krona One (wide geometric sans, condensed to fit), centred. Size from the 1.5 m band: word ~4.26 m wide, caps ~0.39 m. The exterior signs (cream channel letters, red RACE TRACK) are a different sign, not this spec. RACE TRACK set dark maroon as in IMG_4484 f022 (was chrome).

signs.ref: IMG_4484 contact-sheet f047/f048 (fascia and window, oblique, small); signs/i2d_IMG_4484_f049, f051 (neighbours, no lettering)
signs.notes: No name sign in the footage. The unit (s17, west of Prime Time Fitness) shows only a plain mint/teal painted fascia band over a glass front, a big white ballerina-silhouette vinyl on the glass, trophies inside, and a white/grey striped pier. The name 'Inspired 2 Dance' comes from a banner seen reflected/through Hypervelocity's windows (notes_C), not from this front. Modelled as no letters: just the teal band (backer). If a name sign is wanted, the likely look is white vinyl lettering on the teal band, but that is not what the mall shows. The dancer decal (~1.2 m tall, white vinyl on the glass) would be worth adding as a window graphic.

signs.ref: IMG_4457 f003 (mall entrance, near square-on; squared up on the marble band between its top and the door heads), f002; IMG_4458 f001
signs.notes: Mall-side entrance: the post-2012 'JCPenney' wordmark (caps J C P, lowercase 'enney' with a tall x-height) as lit red-face channel letters with dark returns, mounted on the rosso (red-brown veined) marble cladding of the entrance bay, black-framed glass doors below; cream mall wall with a terracotta wainscot either side. A potted palm hides most of the 'e'-'n' in every view. Set in TeX Gyre Heros Bold at 0.85 width (matches the word's width and the x-height); a faint red glow on the marble. Cap height ~0.8 m from the ~1.8 m marble band above the 2.4 m doors. The exterior wordmarks (magenta faces, black returns, on brick) are separate signs outside the mall and aren't built here.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 f020 (near square-on, close; used unwarped), f016-f019 oblique
signs.notes: Journeys' 2020s compass logo: a big pale-grey oval panel (deckled edge, faint dashed 'route' lines printed on it, black 15 cm return) mounted TILTED about 25-30 deg (rising to the right) over the entry, on a purple fascia with a lime-green paint-splash mural. The oval's tilt is real (the letters stand upright in a near-frontal frame), and the backer can't be rotated, so the oval is a traced flat part (an ellipse fitted to its edge). 'Journeys' is hand-drawn faux-neon: pale cyan-white lit tubes (channel, lit, small cyan glow), traced from the bright cores; the overlapping strokes of O-U-R-N merge into one shape (they cross on the real sign too). Compass marks traced as their own parts: two orange chevrons (left of J, after the N), two yellow arrows (above and below the J), a green globe in the O. Dashed route lines not modelled (printed, too faint). Size: oval about 2.4 x 1.2 m (guess, from the 3 m door opening); it hangs below the fascia band (mount_y -0.2). Builder note: unlit narrow parts get glow_pad 0.01, because make_logos.textures() sizes its glow border from glow_pad even with no glow, and a tall 15 cm-wide part at the default 0.25 m pad makes a multi-gigabyte blur (the build hangs).

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f005 (full res frame, oblique ~50 deg from the left, letters ~140 px; rectified with the vanishing point of the letters' base and top lines, width:height of the rectified window chosen 1.5:1 by eye); f001-f006 sheet tiles (whole fascia), IMG_4438 f011-f012
signs.notes: 'Lids' in heavy italic mixed case (L, i with separate dot, d, s), white lit acrylic faces with a grey trim cap and deep (~15 cm) near-black returns, on a painted navy-blue fascia over the entry; a small round (R) mark at the top right of the s, not built. Behind the letters a slightly lighter square ghost panel from an older sign (not built). Traced from the only full-res frame, which is strongly oblique: the letter proportions depend on the rectification aspect (+-15% in width). Size from the 3 m entry: letters ~0.95 m tall, word ~1.25 m wide (+-15%). The scouts' 'flag mark' is not in the frame.

signs.ref: IMG_4408 f037 (square-on, squared up), f010 (oblique letter/depth detail)

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f037 (full-res frame, oblique ~60 deg; squared up on the letters' base and x-height lines, aspect 6:1 chosen by eye so the o/c/e read round); f036 tile
signs.notes: Lowercase 'maurices' (the i has no dot, as on the real sign), teal flat-cut dimensional letters (~5 cm, pin-mounted with a visible gap: shadows on the wall), unlit, on the pale blush-white wall above the entry; teal scalloped fabric awnings with white leaf prints over the windows either side (storefront, not the sign). signs.ref: IMG_4484 f006 (fascia sign, oblique, squared up on the fascia panel's mouldings); contact-sheet f021 (same logo as window vinyl, large)

The game has one sign per store, so only one copy is built. Cap height ~0.3 m (letters ~1/3 of the band).

signs.ref: IMG_4469 photo (full res, near square-on from across the court; crop at 2x); IMG_4471/IMG_4472 (close, from below: letter depth and colours)

Size guessed ~2.4 m wide (letters ~0.4 m), +-15%. Real blue plate shades from navy (left) to royal blue (right): one colour here.

A grey ADA restroom plaque with an arrow hangs on the pier to the right (not modelled).

signs.ref: IMG_4439 f034 (oblique; storefront squared up on the blue surround, aspect ~2.6:1 assumed); f033

The whole storefront is a bright-blue painted box surround with a white inner trim round a full-height glass front; the only 'Rhea Lana's' lettering is a white script LED/neon sign INSIDE on the pink back wall (seen through the glass, too small and blurred to trace) and red/pink posters taped in the windows. If a name sign is wanted, the likely look is the white Rhea Lana's script (as on the interior neon) as vinyl on this blue band, but that is not what the mall shows.

signs.ref: IMG_4484 contact-sheet f055 (whole logo, squared up on the 'SOUTH LOUISIANA' line; soft), signs/sola_IMG_4484_f055 full-res (O-L-A and text sharp, S off the frame edge), f054
signs.notes: SOLA (South Louisiana Center for the Arts) has NO fascia lettering: the curved black textured-stucco band above (the old Sound Shop front) is blank. Its sign is a multicolour vinyl decal on the black glass vestibule panel: a white contour backing with 'S' lime, 'O' a magenta disc with white comedy/tragedy masks, 'L' blue, 'A' orange with a white treble clef, then 'SOUTH LOUISIANA' and 'CENTER FOR THE ARTS' in white heavy sans (Lilita One, condensed). Traced from the contact-sheet tile (the only frame with the whole logo; soft, so edges are smoothed and the mask faces are blobs); the right edge of the white backing is clipped by the squared-up frame by a few cm. The builder can't put it on the glass: mount_y -1.6 drops it from the fascia toward window height; better placed on the storefront glass by hand. Size a guess (~1.6 m wide) from the ~2.5 m glass panel. An older projecting black panel sign (round orange/yellow logo) is glimpsed far away in IMG_4419 only; not modelled.

signs.ref: IMG_4440 f001 (closest, oblique from left; squared up on the roll-shutter panel), IMG_4439 f035
signs.notes: Not a channel-letter sign: Spencer's 2026 front is a faux red-brick storefront with a rusty steel-angle frame; the 'sign' is a spray-painted graffiti 'Spencer's' on the half-raised black roll-down security shutter over the entry, lit only by the mall lights. Backer = the visible shutter (about 2.3 x 1.0 m, guessed from the brick courses). The shutter's background is a red/pink/blue/purple spray-paint wash with horizontal slat lines: the builder takes one backer colour, so it is the median purple (#8c5f96); a printed backer texture would be truer (the format can't take one). Letters: two traced vinyl layers, the black outline/drop-shadow silhouette (also covers the thin white rim) and the orange fill on top (deeper by 3 mm so it sits in front). Orange corrected from the warm frame. The band above is the plain cream mall wall; the piers either side are faux brick.

Lit 0.4: unlit-looking in daylight, probably on at night. Size from the 3 m openings beside it: ~3.3 m wide, M ~0.6 m tall. The exterior parapet sign (unit 1029) is a different sign.

signs.ref: IMG_4433 photo (full res; squared up on the left display-window glass panel), IMG_4492 f033 (square-on, soft: confirms layout and colours)
signs.notes: Wax Utopia has NO fascia sign (the cream stucco band above is blank). Its sign is printed vinyl on the inside of the smoked black glass of the angled display window, about 1.5 m wide, centred roughly 2 m above the floor: 'Wax' in a high-contrast display serif (W and a dusky blue, x bright teal), 'Utopia' below in pale gold with swash U and looped p, a teal swoosh by the i. A round gold-ring 'W/U' monogram (~0.45 m) is on the entry door glass to the right (not modelled). Traced from the IMG_4433 photo squared up on the glass panel; reflections of people and a ceiling-light streak cross the letters, so the hairlines (W thins, a's loop, o and p bowls, U's tail) are hand-drawn over the frame and approximate. The builder can't put it on the recessed, angled glass: mount_y -1.9 drops it to window height on the fascia plane; better to place it on the storefront glass by hand (or render nothing on the fascia). Width guessed from the ~2.6 m glass panel (+-15%).
